prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: preview concept for a classy modern watercolor birthday invitation; no website changes yet.
Input image: edit target, the supplied invitation concept. Keep its airy composition but radically simplify the cake and painting technique.
Primary request: authentic loose minimalist watercolor on almost-white warm paper. The cake must be a small suggestive hand-painted sketch, not a detailed rendered illustration. Represent it with ONLY two or three broad translucent dusty-blush washes for a simple cake cylinder, one loose cream brushstroke for the top, five slender loosely painted candles in pale blush, sage and warm ochre, tiny warm dabs suggesting flames. A simple pale oval brushstroke suggests a plate underneath. Remove the elaborate pedestal completely. No piped cream rosettes, frosting swirls, bead decorations, sprinkles, individual surface details, highlights or contour outlines. Let pigment bleed gently at some edges and leave small unpainted gaps. The cake should resemble a quick elegant watercolor sketch by a stationery illustrator, economical and deliberately unfinished.
At the top, keep one sparse bunting strand, but paint the seven small flags with single translucent watercolor washes, faint fine thread, softly irregular edges, no modeled shading or tiny knots. Restrained dusty blush, sage, pale ochre and soft muted mauve.
Composition: square full-bleed card. The cake is small, about 22% of canvas width, centered at the bottom between y78% and y94%. Delicate flags only in top 14%. Leave central 70% calm, blank almost-white for future live typography. Subtle genuine paper grain only; no noisy faux texture. Classy modern boutique stationery, spacious and minimal. No photorealism, polished 3D, detailed realism, cartoon contours, gradients, elaborate decoration, confetti or ribbon frame. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Output only the finished preview image.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, the supplied minimalist watercolor birthday invitation preview.
Primary request: remove ALL paper texture and grain from the background. Replace the entire background with a perfectly smooth, uniform warm white, approximately #FFFCF7. No mottling, fibers, speckles, noise, shadows, wash, gradients or material texture in the empty background. The card should feel clean and modern on screen.
Preserve the small loose watercolor pink cake at the bottom center and the single pastel watercolor bunting strand at the top, with the same sizes, locations, colors and simple sketch-like details. Keep natural watercolor brush marks ONLY inside the painted cake, candles, plate and pennants. Keep the central space completely blank and smooth. Do not add detail to the cake. Preserve square framing. No text, typography, letters, numbers, borders or watermark. Output only the finished preview artwork.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, the supplied minimalist watercolor birthday invitation preview.
Primary request: add a few delicate hand-painted watercolor sparkles to this exact composition. Add only 8 small airy four-point star sparkles, varying subtly in size, in pale muted warm gold, dusty blush and soft sage. Arrange them loosely near the outer sides and around the small cake, balancing left and right, with ample space between them. Keep them tiny, understated and charming; simple pointed brushstroke stars with soft translucent pigment, no glitter effect, no glow, no shadow, no metallic rendering. Keep the central text area approximately x18%-82%, y22%-61% completely empty.
Constraints: preserve the existing cake, candles, plate, bunting, positions, proportions and loose watercolor appearance exactly. Preserve the completely smooth plain warm-white background, with NO paper grain, mottling, texture, speckles or watercolor wash behind the motifs. No additional confetti, ribbons, decorations, typography, text, numbers, border or watermark. Square full-bleed preview image only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: tall portrait 9:16 birthday invitation artwork for the website.
Input image: approved square Watercolor Wishes design. Make a matching TALL 9:16 version, output portrait canvas, not square.
Keep the exact same simple loose watercolor style, muted pastel palette and motifs. One softly drooping bunting strand with seven plain dusty blush, sage, pale gold and mauve pennants across the very top, occupying the top 12%. Small simple pink watercolor cake centered at bottom, with five slim pastel candles, soft painted flame dabs, a plain cream top and simple oval plate. Keep the cake loosely painted and low in detail. No cream rosettes, fancy frosting, sprinkles, contour outlines or pedestal. Cake and candles occupy x30%-70%, y73%-94%. Eight small delicate four-point watercolor sparkles in pale gold, blush and sage, placed near the outer left/right edges and around the cake, leaving a broad clear central space.
The background is perfectly smooth plain warm white #FFFCF7. Absolutely no paper grain, speckles, mottling, fibers or background wash. Watercolor brush marks exist ONLY inside the cake, candles, pennants and sparkles.
Keep x16%-84%, y19%-65% empty and smooth for editable English/Georgian text. This is a matching portrait re-composition of the approved square design, not a new artistic interpretation. Preserve the soft simplified cake appearance. No added decorations, borders, lettering, text, numbers, logo or watermark. Full-bleed 9:16 artwork only.
